source.title: Katy Times: Council updates floodplain ordinances
City of Katy council agenda/video - amend Ch. 3 Art. 3.02 to adopt 2021 I-codes, 2023 NEC, local amendments (BSC rec. 09-27-2023)

plainLanguage: Katy uses the 2021 International Residential Code and the 2023 National Electrical Code (since about January 2024). In the common R-1 single-family zone, plan on a 25-ft front setback (35 ft on a major street), 25 ft on the street side of a corner lot, a 15-ft rear yard and a 32-ft height limit; many new neighborhoods are planned developments whose plat lines take priority. Katy is not in the state windstorm area. Reports say new homes in a floodplain must sit at or above the 500-year flood level. We could not find Katy's permit fee or utility facility (impact) fees; ask the city for its Adopted Facility Fees list. Katy spans Harris, Fort Bend and Waller counties, so drainage rules depend on where your lot is.
